_comment: Neverforgetyou event text, copied word for word from the old mod (hopedialogue, hopeentity, gloworbhandler). Line markers (kept from the old code): 'YOU:text' = a player line, 'RAW:text' = grey italic narrator line, 'ORB_TOAST:n' = show orb_quotes[n] as a floating toast, 'CHOICE:key' = ask the choice named key under 'choices'. Any other line is spoken by Hope. Section signs are Minecraft colour codes and are kept as written. In the old code every book page was wrapped in italics, so book.italic is true and the pages here have no colour codes. Every text line is 'archivist.key|english': the key is looked up in assets/archivist/archivist_lang/<code>.json (the language picked in the Archivist menu), the English after the bar is the fallback and what the line timing is measured on. The markers stay in front of the key.

book.title: hope
book.author: hope
book.warning_page:
archivist.nfy.book.warning|[ This book contains themes of grief, loss, and love.

Please take care of yourself. ]
pages: archivist.nfy.book.1|It does not hurt the way it used to, but it still hurts. The ache is quieter now, buried under routine and silence. People say time heals everything, but they do not tell you that healing can look like pretending.

archivist.nfy.book.2|I do not cry as much, but i still feel you in moments i cannot explain. A song, a scent, a sudden memory, and it all comes back. The pain has changed shape, but it never really left.

I learned how to carry it without breaking.

archivist.nfy.book.3|I smile more now, but it is a softer kind of smile, the kind that remembers even as it lets go and keeps walking.

I will not reach to you anymore.

archivist.nfy.book.4|I will not check your updates, not search for pieces of your life in places i know you exist. But somewhere inside me, i still wish you well.

It is a quiet kind of love now, one that does not ask for anything in return.
archivist.nfy.book.5|I hope you are finding peace, comfort, and the kind of happiness we could not give each other. Loving you from afar hurts, but it also feels honest.

archivist.nfy.book.6|It reminds me that what we shared was real, even if it ended before we understood how to save it.

I no longer expect to be part of your story, and maybe that acceptance is its own form of healing.
archivist.nfy.book.7|Still, there's a part of me that whispers hope into the world for you, not because i want you back, but because love does not disappear just because distance grows.

archivist.nfy.book.8|And it kept growing. It ate us alive, my dear.

And even though i still try to maintain myself standing, i have to believe that somewhere, somehow, it was worth it.

archivist.nfy.book.9|I wish you nothing but the best, and i'm truly sorry to myself, because every single person, place or attempt i made to forget you only ended up on missing you more every single day.

archivist.nfy.book.10|I know i cannot beg to be noticed the same way i did before.

Letting you be is another way of loving you.

And i hope that way hurts you less.
